title: Storage Addendum Clauses on Notice to Vacate and the Early Termination Fee
content:
A Storage Rental is ended by the resident's signed notice. The notice period, minimum rental and early termination fee are those of the product rented.

**Clause 1 — Notice.** A resident ends a Storage Rental by signing a notice whose end date is at least the product's notice period, in calendar days, after the notice date. On signing, the rental's status moves from active to notice given. The end date is the last rented day.

**Clause 2 — Early termination fee.** When the end date falls before the start date plus the product's minimum rental in months, an early termination fee equal to the product's early termination fee in months multiplied by the rental's monthly rent is billed with the notice. An end date on or after the start date plus the minimum rental carries no early termination fee.

**Clause 3 — Withdrawal.** A notice may be withdrawn until its end date; the rental then returns to active.

**Clause 4 — Return.** On the notice end date the storage unit is emptied and returned, and the rental is vacated.

## The two date tests

| Test | Compared dates | Satisfied when |
|---|---|---|
| Notice period | Notice date and end date | The end date is on or after the notice date plus the notice period in calendar days (equality satisfies) |
| Minimum rental | Start date plus the minimum rental in months, and end date | The end date is on or after that date; an end date before it bills the fee |

## Worked cases (hypothetical Large Storage Unit (5x10) rental)

Hypothetical inputs: start date 10 March; monthly rent $85.00; the product's notice period 30 calendar days, minimum rental 3 months, early termination fee 0.5 month of rent. The start date plus 3 months is 10 June.

| Notice signed | End date | Notice period met? | End date before 10 June? | Billed with the notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 April | 31 May | Yes (earliest allowed 20 May) | Yes | Early termination fee: 0.5 multiplied by $85.00, **$42.50** |
| 11 May | 10 June | Yes (earliest allowed 10 June, equal) | No | No early termination fee |
| 20 May | 10 June | No (earliest allowed 19 June) | — | The end date does not meet Clause 1 |
| 20 May | 19 June | Yes (equal to the earliest allowed) | No | No early termination fee |

## Worked case (hypothetical Bike Storage Locker rental)

The Bike Storage Locker's notice period is 0 days and its minimum rental is 0 months: an end date on the notice date itself meets Clause 1, and no end date falls before the start date plus 0 months, so no early termination fee arises.

## Basis questions

**Is the early termination fee billed at the end date?** No. It is billed with the notice.

**Which monthly rent is used for the fee?** The rental's monthly rent, multiplied by the product's early termination fee in months.

**Can the notice still be withdrawn after the fee is billed?** A notice may be withdrawn until its end date.
